[1] returns-policy.md > Return shipping
## Restocking fee

A restocking fee of 12% of the item price applies to any opened, non-defective item. "Opened"
means the factory seal or shrink wrap has been broken, or the item has been removed from its
inner packaging. An item returned in an unopened, sealed box carries no fee.

The fee is waived when:

- The return is an exchange for another item of equal or greater value.
- The item is defective, as confirmed by customer service or the Repair Center.
- The wrong item was shipped, or the item does not match its product page.
- The customer is a Beacon-tier Lumen Rewards member and the return is their first of the
  calendar year.

The fee is calculated on the price paid after discounts and before tax and shipping. On a Beacon
600 (LS-600) bought at $79.99, the fee is $9.60. On a Sentinel 1000 Pro (LS-1000P) at $219.99,
the fee is $26.40. The fee is never charged on a showroom return made within 7 days of purchase
with the receipt.

## Return shipping

The customer pays return shipping unless the item is defective or the wrong item was shipped.
Customers may use any carrier they like and are responsible for the package until it arrives
at the Hagerstown warehouse; the Customer Service team recommends tracking and insurance on
anything over $100.

A prepaid return label is offered on every mailed return for a flat $8.50, deducted from the
refund. The label is a UPS Ground label addressed to the warehouse and is good for 14 days from
the day it is issued. One label covers one package; a return of more than one package needs a
label per package, each at $8.50.

When the item is defective or the wrong item was shipped, the prepaid label is free and no
restocking fee applies.

## Return authorization numbers

Every mailed return needs a return authorization number before it ships. RA numbers have the form
RA- followed by six digits, for example RA-118204. The number is printed on the packing slip
that comes with the prepaid label and must also be written on the outside of the box.

Customers obtain an RA number by:

- Using "Start a return" on the online store, which issues the number immediately for any
  eligible order and emails it with a packing slip.
- Calling (301) 555-0147 during support hours. The agent creates the return in Hearth and reads
  the number back.

A package that arrives at the warehouse without an RA number is held for 10 business days while
the warehouse tries to match it to an order. If it cannot be matched it is returned to the sender
at the sender's cost. The RA number is valid for 30 days from issue.

[2] faq.md > Who pays for return shipping?
### Is there a restocking fee?

A 12 percent restocking fee applies to opened items that are not defective. There is no fee on an
exchange, on an item that arrived defective, or on an item that is still sealed.

### Who pays for return shipping?

You do, unless the item is defective or we sent the wrong thing. If you would rather not arrange
shipping yourself, we can email you a prepaid label for a flat $8.50, which we deduct from your
refund.

### How long until I see my refund?

Your refund goes back to the original payment method within 7 business days of the return
arriving at our Hagerstown warehouse. Your bank may take a few more days to post it.

[3] customer-service-playbook.md > Restocking fee and return shipping
### Issuing an RA number

Every mailed return needs a return authorization number in the form RA-xxxxxx (six digits), for
example RA-118204. Customers get one themselves through Start a return on the online store, which
has issued RA numbers automatically since Hearth 4.1. On the phone, open the order in the Hearth
admin, choose Create return, pick the items and the reason, and read the RA number back to the
customer. Also email it. A return that arrives at Hagerstown without an RA number waits in the
"no RA" bin until someone matches it, which adds days to the refund, so always issue one.

In-store returns at either showroom do not need an RA number, only the packing slip or the order
number.

### Restocking fee and return shipping

A 12% restocking fee applies to opened, non-defective items. It is waived on exchanges and on
defective items. It is not charged on items returned unopened. Say the fee before you issue the RA
number; nobody should learn about it from the refund amount.

Return shipping is paid by the customer unless the item is defective or we shipped the wrong item.
We offer a prepaid return label for a flat $8.50, deducted from the refund. For a defective item
or our mistake, send the label at no charge and do not charge the restocking fee.

### Refunds

A refund goes to the original payment method within 7 business days of the return arriving at
the Hagerstown warehouse. Tell the customer the clock starts on arrival, not on the day they
ship, and that their bank may take a few more days to show it. Refunds over $500 need Tomas
Reyes's approval before they are released (see Goodwill and approvals).

[4] release-notes.md > Highlights
## 4.1 — May 19, 2026

### Highlights

Start a return online. A customer can begin a return from the order page, choose the items and
the reason, and get a return authorization number (RA-, six digits) at once instead of calling.
The prepaid return label at $8.50 is offered as an option and the amount is shown as a deduction
from the refund before the customer confirms.

The return window is now counted from the delivery date instead of the ship date. The window is
still 40 days, but the clock starts when the carrier records delivery, not when the box leaves
Hagerstown. This came out of the winter returns review: a box that sat with the carrier for
nine days was costing the customer nine days of their window. Orders shipped before May 19 had
their windows recalculated from the delivery date too.

Order lookup without an account. The order number and the email address on the order are enough
to see the status, tracking and the return option.

### Changes

- Start a return online; RA numbers issued automatically and emailed with the instructions.
- Return window counted from the delivery date (was the ship date).
- Order lookup by order number and email, no account needed.
- Returns on orders delivered to a showroom for pickup can be started online too, for return
  in store.

### RET-01 Return window passed

Hello {name}, thank you for getting in touch about order {order}. Our return window is 40 days
from the delivery date, and tracking shows this order was delivered on {delivered}, which puts it
outside the window as of {deadline}. I am sorry I cannot open a return for it. If the item has a
defect, the standard warranty covers it for 2 years from purchase, and I would be glad to start a
warranty claim for you.

### RET-02 RA number issued

Hello {name}, your return of {items} from order {order} is authorized under RA-{ra}. Please write
that number on the outside of the box and include the packing slip. Send it to Lantern Supply Co.
Returns, 1180 Downsville Pike, Dock B, Hagerstown, MD 21740. {label_sentence} Your refund of
{amount} will go to your original payment method within 7 business days of the return arriving
at our warehouse.

### SHP-01 Package lost

Hello {name}, I am sorry your order {order} has not arrived. Tracking shows it has been more than
10 business days past the expected delivery date, so I have shipped a replacement today under
order {replacement}; tracking will follow by email. We will take the claim up with the carrier
ourselves, and you do not need to do anything further.
